ul.li: Separation of concerns: distinct data, configuration, modelling and reporting layers
Governed data pathway: controlled sources support consistent analysis
Human-in-the-loop: users retain control of assumptions and decisions
Traceability: data, assumptions and transformations remain identifiable

Controlled extensibility: modular components support future change
Data minimisation: only required modelling data is processed
Governance by design: validation, access control and standardisation are embedded
